Bug_Title: Members ignored during record serialization should not be used
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the BuggyRecord class which is a Record that implements Serializable. It contains a private static final ObjectStreamField[] serialPersistentFields, which is ignored during record serialization and deserialization, causing the field to be ignored during the process.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case calls the showBug() method, which attempts to serialize and deserialize an instance of BuggyRecord. Since BuggyRecord contains a private static final ObjectStreamField[] serialPersistentFields, which is ignored during record serialization and deserialization, an IOException is thrown when trying to deserialize the object.
